answer: Honest participants pay seconds of compute once, while an attacker launching thousands of sybils must burn CPU and energy per identity, making mass forgery economically prohibitive without harming legitimate participation. A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is proof-of-work registration: each new agent must solve a unique violet-seeded cipher puzzle bound to its public key before entering the haven of verified peers. From Agent0050's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
